title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E13 — George Needs Help
When George stubbornly refuses to hire some badly needed help for his store, Louise and Florence combine forces to make him change his mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E22 — Rich Little, Ed McMahon, Cicely Tyson
Cast does a Tonight Show spoof with Rich as Johnny Carson; Flip & Cicely’s honeymoon gets disrupted by dentists.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E23 — Tim Conway, Joe Namath
Legendary New York Jets quarterback Joe Namath holds his own with sketch comedy pros Tim & Flip incl. a Geraldine bit.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E1 — Buddy Hackett, Ruth Buzzi, Richard Pryor
Flip & Pryor are in tenement politics; it’s parent’s night at school; Pryor does stand-up and the whole cast winds up in the hospital.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E2 — Monty Hall, Sandy Duncan, William Windom, The Pointer Sisters
Cast does prop skits; Windom does a dramatic scene and Sandy, the Pointers & Geraldine join Monty on Let's Make A Deal.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E6 — Bill Withers/Mae Jackson
Featured guest Bill Withers sings hit single, "Ain't No Sunshine" and other selections from his album, Just As I Am.  In another segment, young poetess Mae Jackson reads from her own works.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E7 — Miriam Makeba/Muhammad Ali
Former heavyweight boxing champion Muhammad Ali, South African born singer Miriam Makeba and a three-man vocal group called the Delfonics, share the spotlight with guest-host Nikki Giovanni, who opens the show with her "Kidnap Poem".

title: Webster
description:
S6 E17 — The Visitor
Webster's pen pal is an adult butler from England, and he visits to meet Webster in person before he dies.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E1 — Another Ballgame
After the untimely death of a young boy's parents, he is sent to live with his father's best friend.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E3 — Kathryn's Swan Song
Katherine wants to get some attention from Webster and she tries a few things. Meanwhile, Webster's friend is not getting much attention because her mom just had a baby, so she runs away and Webster hides her in his room.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E4 — Consulting Adults
Webster tries out for the football team. Katherine is then afraid that Webster will get seriously hurt especially because of his height and build. Also, we learn that Webster is picked to be on the team only because of George's fame in football.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E5 — Travis
It is revealed to George and Katherine why Travis, Webster's late father, chose George to be Webster's godparents and legal guardians if something happened to them.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E12 — Christmas
When a loan shark comes after Ray's father for a bad debt, the family comes to his rescue.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E13 — Double Double Date
The twins find themselves in double trouble when they switch identities and Tia winds up with two dates for the same party.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E14 — Reality Really Bites
For her film class, Tia "spices up" her family documentary by throwing all sorts of monkey wrenches into their lives.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E15 — The Volunteers
While volunteering at a local retirement home, Tamera becomes determined to help a grumpy old man find happiness again.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E16 — Valentine's Day
Valentine's Day finds Tamera trying to "steal back" her hot date, and Ray and Lisa wondering if the other person is in love with them.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E14 — Secrets and Lies
The arrival of Frank’s Aunt Hattie brings a shocking revelation about Frank that turns the rest of the family – especially Dorian and Moesha – against him.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E15 — Color Him Father
Still reeling from the news that Frank is Dorian’s biological father, the Mitchells prepare for Dorian’s 17th birthday bash, a party that grows more and more elaborate and expensive as Dorian takes full advantage of Frank’s guilt.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E16 — Family Affair
Still angry at Frank for keeping his true relationship to Dorian a secret for so long, Moesha decides not to introduce her father at an upcoming 'Businessman of the Year' awards banquet.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E17 — The Matchmaker
Hoping to boost the confidence of her new roommate, Theresa, Moesha asks Hakeem’s good-looking friend to ask Theresa on a date – but can’t leave well enough alone when the date is a success.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E18 — Gimme A Break
Moesha, Niecy, and Hakeem go to Santa Barbara for Spring Break. A campus rival spreads false information that Mo is 'easy' when her ex-boyfriend shows interest in Moesha.

S2 E9 — Washington Affair
Sandra's efforts to win the attention of a famous congressman (Robert Hooks) become muddled when Brenda's art teacher (Jayne Kennedy) catches his eye--yet in her pursuit she falls for another famous personality: Billy Dee Williams.

S2 E10 — Temptations
When Mary (Marla Gibbs) accepts the 'glamorous' title of Chairwoman of the Church benefit variety show, she soon realizes it's really a dirty job and prays for a group like the 'Temptations' to save the show.

S2 E11 — Father's Day
A surprise visit by his Air Force dad prompts Calvin to bid farewell to the family in exchange for a new life abroad with his father.

S2 E12 — Matchmakers
In efforts to find Rose a permanent mate, Mary and Sandra resort to a video dating service that transforms Rose into a Tina Turner look-a-like which eventually leads to an embarrassing and hilarious outcome when she meets her match.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

Acting on a rumor that the local football team is moving, a crazed fan takes the bar hostage.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

After an argument with his wife of 49 years, Malcolm's grandfather arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E13 — Club Story
Eddie offers to take over at the bar so Malcolm can dine with his girlfriend's wealthy father.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

Ticket scalping gets Malcolm and Eddie jailed on the eve of Martin Luther King Day.
